get.description: Requires `unit` (what counts as one produced unit). One row per (asset, currency). Assets without BOTH production (in the given unit) and expense events are omitted — a currency cannot be inferred without an expense row. The expense total is not unit-filtered: all of the asset's expenses are attributed to the queried production unit, so this number is only meaningful for single-output assets.
